boundary: Static engineering-directory inventory. Dynamic calls, external shared components, runtime text and actual visible states require separate review. No GUI or production coverage rate.

selectedKeys.zh: 我已核对声明模型及依据，确认仅保存独立实验试算；理解假设未核实且结果不构成工程批准。
selectedKeys.en: I have checked the declared model and basis and confirm saving an independent experimental trial only. I understand that assumptions are unverified and results do not constitute engineering approval.

selectedKeys.zh: 说明模型适用范围、观测来源、单位和随机假设依据。保存不代表来源或模型假设已核实。
selectedKeys.en: Describe where the model applies, where observations come from, and how their units and stochastic assumptions are defined. Saving does not verify sources or assumptions.

selectedKeys.zh: 仅供声明模型试算：模型假设和来源真实性未核实，不代表工程合格、规范符合或真人签认；不会替换正式平差权、删除观测或批准成果。
selectedKeys.en: Declared-model trials only. Model assumptions and source authenticity are unverified. Results are not engineering acceptance, standards conformity or a professional signature. Formal adjustment weights, observations and approvals are unchanged.

selectedKeys.zh: 已停止等待。可查看试算历史确认记录是否保存。
selectedKeys.en: Stopped waiting. Check trial history to see whether the record was saved.

selectedKeys.zh: 白化因子条件估计 {{whitening}} · 归一设计条件估计 {{design}}
selectedKeys.en: Whitening factor condition estimate {{whitening}} · Normalized design condition estimate {{design}}

selectedKeys.zh: 检测到内容不一致的重复记录，请检查历史后再操作。
selectedKeys.en: A conflicting trial record was found. Review history before trying again.

selectedKeys.zh: 试算数值收敛 · 不代表工程合格
selectedKeys.en: Numerical trial convergence · Not engineering acceptance

selectedKeys.zh: 协方差非对称正定或数值无法解析
selectedKeys.en: Covariance is not symmetric positive definite or is numerically unresolved

selectedKeys.zh: 未能确定临界幅值区间
selectedKeys.en: Critical magnitude could not be bracketed

selectedKeys.zh: 在所提供随机模型下，各声明偏差分量均为零。
selectedKeys.en: Each stated bias component is zero under the supplied stochastic model.

selectedKeys.zh: 在所提供随机模型下，至少一个声明偏差分量不为零。
selectedKeys.en: At least one stated bias component is non-zero under the supplied stochastic model.

selectedKeys.zh: 模型假设与来源资料尚未独立核验。已记录声明不代表工程验收合格或专业签名已获核实。
selectedKeys.en: The model assumptions and source materials have not been independently verified. A recorded declaration does not establish engineering acceptance or an authenticated professional signature.

selectedKeys.zh: 检验来源：{{source}} · 显著性水平 α = {{alpha}} · 多重比较校正：{{correction}}
selectedKeys.en: Test source: {{source}} · Significance level α = {{alpha}} · Multiple-comparison correction: {{correction}}

selectedKeys.zh: 所声明统计检验的联合评估
selectedKeys.en: Combined evaluation of the stated statistical tests

selectedKeys.zh: 需先明确检验假设，再解释结果。
selectedKeys.en: The hypothesis needs clarification before interpretation.

selectedKeys.zh: 各声明统计量与其假定的原假设分布相符。
selectedKeys.en: Each stated statistic is consistent with its assumed null distribution.

selectedKeys.zh: 至少一个声明统计量与其假定的原假设分布不符。
selectedKeys.en: At least one stated statistic is inconsistent with its assumed null distribution.

selectedKeys.zh: 本次试算未记录专业复核或签认。
selectedKeys.en: No professional review or signoff is recorded for this trial.

selectedKeys.zh: 声明为已知的先验绝对观测协方差
selectedKeys.en: Stated known prior absolute observation covariance

selectedKeys.zh: 已记录确认，签认仍需核验
selectedKeys.en: Confirmation recorded; signature still requires verification

selectedKeys.zh: 所提供协方差模型，来源待复核
selectedKeys.en: Supplied covariance model; source needs review

selectedKeys.zh: 所提供模型，适用性待复核
所声明的检验来源，尚待核验
固定线性模型 · 广义 w 诊断
selectedKeys.en: Fixed linear model · generalized w diagnostic
A priori weighted residual sum of squares

selectedKeys.zh: 当前计算条件与保存时不同，无法确认结果一致；这不表示记录遭到篡改。
selectedKeys.en: Current calculation conditions differ from when this record was saved, so the same result cannot be confirmed. This does not by itself mean the record was altered.

selectedKeys.zh: 已计算检验族，请逐项查看成员状态
已取消导出，未保存文件。
selectedKeys.en: Export was cancelled. No file was saved.

selectedKeys.zh: 文件保存失败。已核验的试算记录仍可再次导出。
selectedKeys.en: Could not save the file. The checked trial remains available for another export.

selectedKeys.zh: 已保存到 {{path}}。该独立试算记录仅供复核，不是批准的工程成果。
selectedKeys.en: Saved as {{path}}. This independent trial record is for review only; it is not an approved engineering deliverable.

selectedKeys.zh: 试算未完成。请查看历史确认是否已保存结果，再决定是否重试。
selectedKeys.en: The trial did not finish. Check history to see whether a result was saved, then retry if needed.

selectedKeys.zh: 最终方差下重算的参数（{{unit}}）
功能模型秩亏或数值条件不满足
selectedKeys.en: Functional model rank or conditioning boundary

selectedKeys.zh: 初始 score 满足停止条件
selectedKeys.en: Initial score satisfies the stopping policy

selectedKeys.zh: IRLS 设计秩或条件数未满足要求
selectedKeys.en: IRLS design rank or conditioning is unresolved

selectedKeys.zh: 第 {{index}} 次迭代 · 目标值 {{objective}} · score {{score}}
仅支持独立观测及固定外部尺度。须声明完整线性模型、初值和停止条件；试算不能替换正式观测权。
selectedKeys.en: Independent observations and a fixed external scale only. Supply the full linear model, initial values and stopping policy. This trial cannot replace formal observation weights.

selectedKeys.zh: 固定尺度 Huber 试算
尺度与独立性未经核验。乘子与派生 IRLS 权仅为试算值；不提供协方差、高斯 WLS 精度、删点操作或工程验收结论。
selectedKeys.en: Scale and independence are unverified. Multipliers and derived IRLS weights are trial values only. No covariance, Gaussian WLS precision, observation removal or engineering approval is provided.

selectedKeys.zh: 尚未建立唯一性；这不等于证明极小值不唯一。
selectedKeys.en: Uniqueness is not established. This does not prove that the minimizer is nonunique.

selectedKeys.zh: 目标函数增量超出软件数值预算
selectedKeys.en: Objective increased beyond the software numerical budget

selectedKeys.zh: score 舍入估计 {{budget}} · 预测步长 {{step}} · 相对目标变化 {{change}}
selectedKeys.en: Score roundoff estimate {{budget}} · prediction step {{step}} · relative objective change {{change}}

selectedKeys.zh: score 精度不足以判断声明容差
selectedKeys.en: Score precision is insufficient for the declared tolerance

selectedKeys.zh: score、预测步长和目标变化均满足停止条件
selectedKeys.en: Score, prediction step and objective change satisfy the stopping policy

selectedKeys.zh: 迭代停滞，尚未满足 score 条件
selectedKeys.en: The iteration stalled before satisfying the score policy

selectedKeys.zh: 最多 {{iterations}} 次迭代 · score 容差 {{score}} · 预测步长容差 {{step}} · 目标变化容差 {{objective}}
selectedKeys.en: Maximum {{iterations}} iterations · score tolerance {{score}} · prediction-step tolerance {{step}} · objective-change tolerance {{objective}}

selectedKeys.zh: 严格内点秩满足数值充分条件；未认证唯一性。
selectedKeys.en: Strict-inlier rank satisfies a numerical sufficient condition; uniqueness is not certified.

selectedKeys.zh: 导入已整理的测量模型资料
明确声明的分组与初始方差
无法核验已保存的试算记录，不能恢复。
selectedKeys.en: The saved trial could not be verified, so it cannot be restored.

selectedKeys.zh: 可使用当前水准平差资料开展独立试算，也可在高级区域导入模型。原平差成果及观测始终保留。
selectedKeys.en: Run independent trials using the current leveling adjustment, or import a model under Advanced. Formal adjustment results and observations are preserved.

selectedKeys.zh: 计算资料不符合所选模型要求，请核查参数、单位及观测关系。
selectedKeys.en: The data does not meet the selected model requirements. Check parameters, units and observation relationships.

selectedKeys.zh: 未能核验已保存的试算结果，因此暂不显示。
selectedKeys.en: The saved trial result could not be verified, so it is not shown.

selectedKeys.zh: 第 {{index}} 轮 · 最大相对变化 {{change}}
功能法矩阵条件数 {{functional}} · 随机法矩阵条件数 {{stochastic}}
selectedKeys.en: Functional normal condition {{functional}} · Stochastic normal condition {{stochastic}}

selectedKeys.zh: 已记录 {{count}} 轮 · 残差自由度 {{df}}
selectedKeys.en: {{count}} iterations recorded · Residual degrees of freedom {{df}}

selectedKeys.zh: 当前项目的试算资料或保存记录已达上限。请缩小试算范围或改用其他项目。
selectedKeys.en: The project has reached a limit for trial size or saved records. Reduce the scope or use another project.

selectedKeys.zh: 正在执行试算并核对结果…
selectedKeys.en: Running the trial and checking the result…

selectedKeys.zh: 高级：导入独立声明模型
selectedKeys.en: Advanced: import a separately declared model

selectedKeys.zh: 没有可显示的历史记录。
非正分量停止，候选保留但不接受
selectedKeys.en: Stopped at a nonpositive component; candidate retained but not accepted

selectedKeys.zh: 该项目内找不到此试算记录。
selectedKeys.en: This trial record was not found in the project.

selectedKeys.zh: 达到数值范围或精度边界，未接受结果
selectedKeys.en: Numerical range or precision boundary; no result accepted

selectedKeys.zh: 本地计算服务暂不可用，请稍后重试。
selectedKeys.en: The local calculation service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

selectedKeys.zh: 暂无法确认是否保存。请先检查试算历史，再决定重试或重新开始。
selectedKeys.en: The save could not be confirmed. Check trial history before retrying or starting another record.

selectedKeys.zh: 概率低于支持的数值范围
试算工作量达到当前时间窗上限，请稍后重试原请求。
selectedKeys.en: The trial workload limit for this time window has been reached. Retry the original request later.

selectedKeys.zh: 协方差不对称；未取平均修补
selectedKeys.en: Covariance is asymmetric; no averaging repair was performed

selectedKeys.zh: 参考点集合由用户选定，其物理稳定性尚未判定，资料真实性及跨期关系尚未独立核实。本试算不进行显著性检验，不修改正式坐标，也不构成工程验收。
selectedKeys.en: The reference points were selected by the user. Their physical stability, source authenticity and relationships between epochs have not been independently verified. This trial does not perform a significance test, change official coordinates or constitute engineering acceptance.

selectedKeys.zh: 坐标差 = 第二期 − 第一期；位移 = 坐标差 − 指定参考平移。
selectedKeys.en: Coordinate difference = second − first; displacement = difference − declared reference shift.

selectedKeys.zh: 跨期关系：采用提供的完整交叉协方差
selectedKeys.en: Epoch relationship: uses the supplied complete cross-covariance

selectedKeys.zh: 协方差特征值检查达到迭代上限
selectedKeys.en: Covariance eigenvalue check reached its iteration limit

selectedKeys.zh: 参考定义：等权均值；不宣称精度最优或参考点稳定。
selectedKeys.en: Reference definition: equal mean; no optimal-precision or stable-reference claim.

selectedKeys.zh: 参考定义：GLS 加权均值；奇异或病态时停止，不自动转为等权。
selectedKeys.en: Reference definition: GLS weighted mean; singular or ill-conditioned input stops without equal-weight fallback.

selectedKeys.zh: 联合协方差不满足半正定数值检查
selectedKeys.en: Joint covariance fails the numerical positive-semidefinite check

selectedKeys.zh: 跨期关系：按两期观测相互独立处理
selectedKeys.en: Epoch relationship: observations are assumed independent

selectedKeys.zh: 仅支持 2–32 个一维对应点，至少 2 个指定参考点。声明完整坐标协方差、点号双射和跨期独立或相关关系，明确选择 GLS 或等权参考定义；不会自动筛选稳定点。
selectedKeys.en: Requires 2–32 mapped 1D points and at least 2 declared references, complete coordinate covariance, a full point bijection and explicit epoch dependence. Choose GLS or equal-reference definition; stable points are not selected automatically.

selectedKeys.zh: 两历元指定参考集合试算

selectedKeys.en: Mapped point and epoch point IDs
Point mapping, reference weights and displacements

selectedKeys.zh: 联合协方差：数值正定检查通过；不认证模型真实性。
selectedKeys.en: Joint covariance: numerical positive-definite check passed; model authenticity is not certified.

selectedKeys.zh: 参考协方差奇异、病态或未分辨；未切换方法
selectedKeys.en: Reference covariance is singular, ill-conditioned or unresolved; the requested method was retained

selectedKeys.zh: 软件舍入估计：坐标 {{coordinate}} {{unit}}，协方差 {{covariance}} {{unit}}²；不是认证误差界。
selectedKeys.en: Software roundoff estimates: coordinate {{coordinate}} {{unit}}, covariance {{covariance}} {{unit}}²; these are not certified error bounds.

selectedKeys.zh: 指定参考集合下的两历元比较
协方差尺度超出已支持的数值范围
selectedKeys.en: Covariance scale is outside the supported numerical domain

selectedKeys.zh: 联合协方差：半正定或数值容差内未分辨。仍传播原矩阵，未证明数学半正定，未修补特征值。
selectedKeys.en: Joint covariance: semidefinite or unresolved within numerical tolerance. The original matrix is propagated without eigenvalue repair; mathematical positive semidefiniteness is not proved.

selectedKeys.zh: 数值可解析 · 未作工程判定
已读取的独立试算记录
每行：观测号,起点,终点,高差(m),先验标准差(m),来源记录。仅限已有点号与同一基准；新增资料由你声明，未经过原资料来源核验。
selectedKeys.en: One row: observation ID,from,to,height difference (m),prior standard deviation (m),source record. Existing point IDs and the same datum only. Additional sources are caller-declared and are not covered by the original source verification.

selectedKeys.zh: 依据资料「{{name}}」及当前固定基准水准平差。逐条先验精度来自资料声明；来源完整性已复核，现场精度与独立性仍需工程复核。仅供独立试算。
selectedKeys.en: Based on “{{name}}” and its current fixed-datum leveling adjustment. Prior precision is source-declared; source integrity was rechecked, while field precision and independence require engineering review. Independent trial only.

selectedKeys.zh: {{points}} 点 · {{observations}} 高差观测 · {{parameters}} 待定高程 · {{redundancy}} 个多余观测
selectedKeys.en: {{points}} points · {{observations}} height differences · {{parameters}} unknown heights · {{redundancy}} redundant observations

selectedKeys.zh: 固定基准点：{{points}}。试算沿用原平差基准，不改写正式成果。
selectedKeys.en: Fixed datum points: {{points}}. The trial retains the original datum and formal results.

selectedKeys.zh: 预先声明的检验族名称
请先在处理页完成水准资料校核和平差，再选择当前成果。
selectedKeys.en: Validate and adjust leveling data on the Process page, then select its current result.

selectedKeys.zh: 采用源资料逐条先验标准差的平方，保留完整观测及参数协方差；未乘以本次后验方差因子。参数为初始高程的改正数，单位 m。
selectedKeys.en: Uses the square of each source-declared prior standard deviation and preserves full observation and parameter covariance. No posterior variance factor is applied. Parameters are height corrections in m.

selectedKeys.zh: 本次试算对应的原始资料
selectedKeys.en: Original material used for this trial

selectedKeys.zh: 外部尺度来源与适用依据（不能使用本批后验尺度）
selectedKeys.en: External scale source and applicability (not the current posterior scale)

selectedKeys.zh: 读取当前已校核水准资料及同一平差成果。仅支持明确逐条先验精度的独立高差观测；平面、三维及相对路线权不适用。
selectedKeys.en: Read the current admitted leveling source and exact adjustment. Only independent height differences with explicit per-row absolute prior precision are supported; planar, 3D and relative route weights are unavailable.

selectedKeys.zh: 按源资料先验精度比例形成一个尺度组；不自动推断仪器或路线分组。试算估计统一尺度，不修改正式权值。
selectedKeys.en: One scale group preserves the source prior precision ratios. Instrument or route groups are not inferred. Estimates a common scale without changing formal weights.

selectedKeys.zh: 项目资料自本次试算后已变化，不能将旧记录恢复到当前项目。
selectedKeys.en: Project data has changed since this trial was created, so it cannot be restored into the current project.

selectedKeys.zh: 误差声明为零均值、相互独立，使用已知先验绝对方差；不作正态分布主张。参数与观测使用相同单位，系数无量纲。
selectedKeys.en: Errors are declared zero-mean and independent with known absolute prior variances; no normality claim. Parameters share the observation unit and coefficients are dimensionless.

selectedKeys.zh: 拒绝追加：原有模型秩或条件数不满足要求。
selectedKeys.en: Append refused: existing model rank or conditioning is unsupported.

selectedKeys.zh: 原有 {{base}} 条 · 追加 {{appended}} 条 · 总观测 {{total}} 条
拒绝结果：增量与批处理比较超过数值策略阈值。
selectedKeys.en: Result refused: incremental and batch comparison exceeds the numerical policy.

selectedKeys.zh: 固定线性、固定基准、独立零均值误差与已知先验绝对方差；原有模型须满列秩且有正多余观测。最多 16 个同量纲参数、128 条追加观测、256 条总观测；不支持相关、非线性、动态模型或实时外业状态。
selectedKeys.en: Fixed linear model and datum, zero-mean independent errors and known absolute prior variances. The existing model must have full column rank and positive redundancy. Up to 16 same-unit parameters, 128 appended and 256 total observations. No correlation, nonlinear/dynamic model or realtime field state.

selectedKeys.zh: 静态线性观测追加试算
加权残差平方和 {{sse}} · 自由度 {{df}} · 后验方差因子估计 {{posterior}}。后验值仅作诊断，未用于缩放先验协方差或修改权重。
selectedKeys.en: Weighted residual sum of squares {{sse}} · Degrees of freedom {{df}} · Posterior variance factor estimate {{posterior}}. Diagnostic only; not used to scale prior covariance or alter weights.

selectedKeys.zh: 追加后参数先验协方差
拒绝追加：更新后的模型秩或条件数不满足要求。
selectedKeys.en: Append refused: updated model rank or conditioning is unsupported.

selectedKeys.zh: 拒绝计算：先验方差比超出支持范围。
selectedKeys.en: Calculation refused: prior variance ratio exceeds the supported range.

selectedKeys.zh: 已满足声明的停止条件
p 大于调整后的 alpha
selectedKeys.en: p is above the adjusted alpha

selectedKeys.zh: Bonferroni 调整后 p 值
p 小于调整后的 alpha
selectedKeys.en: p is below the adjusted alpha

selectedKeys.zh: 临界幅值与数值分辨区间
超出支持的分布定义域
检验族 {{id}} · 完整分母 {{count}} · 检验族 alpha {{alpha}} · 成员 alpha {{memberAlpha}}
selectedKeys.en: Family {{id}} · full denominator {{count}} · family alpha {{alpha}} · member alpha {{memberAlpha}}

selectedKeys.zh: 显示区间表示软件分辨率政策，并非认证误差界。单项失败和缺失统计量保留显示，始终计入完整检验族。
selectedKeys.en: The displayed intervals describe a software resolution policy, not certified error bounds. Individual failures and missing statistics remain visible and retain their place in the full family.

selectedKeys.zh: 须在统计量之前声明完整检验族。输入须按所声明分布提供精确标量，不传播上游数值误差；缺失和失败成员仍计入 Bonferroni 分母。
selectedKeys.en: Declare the complete family before its statistics. Supply exact scalar inputs under the declared distribution; upstream numerical errors are not propagated. Missing and failed members remain in the Bonferroni denominator.

selectedKeys.zh: 全部预声明检验族成员
检验族预声明与分布假设未经核验。标量比较不构成观测分类、删点或规范符合性结论，也不传播上游统计量的不确定性。
selectedKeys.en: Family predeclaration and distribution assumptions are unverified. These scalar comparisons do not classify observations, delete points, or establish standards compliance. No upstream statistic uncertainty is propagated.

selectedKeys.zh: 未提供统计量，仍计入分母
selectedKeys.en: No statistic supplied; retained in denominator

selectedKeys.zh: 随机模型不可辨识或数值条件不满足
selectedKeys.en: Stochastic model identifiability or conditioning boundary

selectedKeys.zh: 最多 {{iterations}} 轮 · 相对停止阈值 {{tolerance}}
selectedKeys.en: At most {{iterations}} iterations · Relative stopping tolerance {{tolerance}}

selectedKeys.zh: 试算服务暂不可用，请稍后重试。
selectedKeys.en: The trial service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

selectedKeys.zh: 不可探测或数值未分辨
使用当前水准平差资料
资料与所选试算方法不匹配。请核对必填数据、单位、模型维度和数值范围。
selectedKeys.en: The supplied material does not fit this trial method. Check required values, units, model dimensions and numeric ranges.

selectedKeys.zh: 固定满列秩线性模型、独立观测及互斥对角方差组；最多 128 条观测、32 个参数、8 组。初值和候选分量范围 1e−18～1e18，相对方差 1e−8～1e8，观测绝对值不超过 1e6；只支持声明的 m 或 mm。非正分量停止，不夹紧、不自动换初值。
selectedKeys.en: Fixed full-rank linear models with independent observations and disjoint diagonal variance groups; at most 128 observations, 32 parameters and 8 groups. Initial and candidate variances: 1e−18 to 1e18; relative variances: 1e−8 to 1e8; observation magnitude at most 1e6, in declared m or mm. Nonpositive components stop the trial without clamping or automatic reinitialization.

selectedKeys.zh: VCE · 互斥分组方差分量试算
数值收敛仅是此模型的停止状态，不代表工程合格或随机模型正确。未提供分量协方差，不替换正式权。
selectedKeys.en: Numerical convergence is a stopping state for this model only, not engineering acceptance or confirmation of the stochastic model. Component covariance is not provided and formal weights are not replaced.

selectedKeys.zh: 此表单按单个估计参数和单个观测组试算。每行填写一个观测值，设计系数为 1，并采用所列相对方差；多参数控制网请导入已整理的模型资料。

selectedKeys.en: Explain observation {{observationId}}, its source evidence, and anything requiring review.

selectedKeys.en: This adjustment uses fixed known points. Free-network and minimum-constraint methods are not currently available.

selectedKeys.zh: 我确认释放全部固定点约束，接受零和约束与上述权值策略，仅运行独立试算。
selectedKeys.en: I acknowledge releasing all fixed-point constraints, the zero-sum constraint and the weight policy above, for an independent trial only.

selectedKeys.zh: 仅供试算；不改变正式平差、点位约束或交付成果，不作工程合格判定。
selectedKeys.en: Trial only. Formal adjustments, point constraints and deliverables are unchanged. No engineering acceptance decision.

selectedKeys.zh: 全部点作为未知点求解，释放原有固定点约束；采用 Σ(H − H₀) = 0。H₀ 取已声明高程，缺失时以 0 作初始近似值。该约束不建立物理高程基准，也不能据此认定稳定点。
selectedKeys.en: Every point is solved as unknown, releasing all fixed-point constraints with Σ(H − H₀) = 0. H₀ uses declared heights or an explicit zero initial approximation when missing. This does not establish a physical height datum or identify stable points.

selectedKeys.en: The trial exceeds 64 points or 256 observations. Use a smaller network.

selectedKeys.en: The network is disconnected and has no unique zero-sum solution. Check point IDs and connections.

selectedKeys.en: The trial did not complete. You can retry after checking the source and network.

selectedKeys.en: This trial conflicts with an existing result. Reopen the trial page before running again.

selectedKeys.en: Insufficient redundant observations. Add independent observations before retrying.

selectedKeys.en: The trial result could not be verified against the selected survey source. No results are displayed.

selectedKeys.zh: 本次权值：完整路线长度倒数，或全部长度缺失时的单位权。

selectedKeys.zh: 正在校验来源并读取试算…
selectedKeys.en: Validating the source and loading the trial…

selectedKeys.zh: 权值声明不完整或混用。请完整提供全部标准差，或全部路线长度；全部缺失长度才允许单位权。
selectedKeys.en: Weight declarations are incomplete or mixed. Supply all sigmas or all route lengths; unit weights require every route length to be absent.

selectedKeys.zh: 当前没有可恢复的试算记录。
selectedKeys.en: No trial records are available to restore.

selectedKeys.zh: 数值条件未达到试算要求。请检查权值比例、网络几何和高程尺度，结果未被采用。
selectedKeys.en: Numerical conditions did not meet trial requirements. Check weight ratios, network geometry and height scales. No results were accepted.

selectedKeys.zh: 本地计算服务 未连接，试算结果已清空；连接恢复后请重新读取或运行。
selectedKeys.en: local processing service is offline. Trial results are cleared; read or run again after reconnection.

selectedKeys.en: Trial result · Statistical assumptions unverified · Engineering decision not evaluated

selectedKeys.en: Original data has not passed pre-calculation checks. Review the original file and check records, then retry.

selectedKeys.zh: 测量来源或试算结果已变化或不一致，结果已清空。请重新导入并校验来源后再试。
selectedKeys.en: The survey source or trial result changed or is inconsistent. Results are cleared. Reimport and validate the source before retrying.

selectedKeys.en: Unsupported observations. Use independent height differences with original record locators.

selectedKeys.en: Weights use fully declared inverse squared sigmas, otherwise complete inverse route lengths; unit weights apply only when every route length is absent. Partial declarations are not mixed. The weight model and statistical assumptions are unverified; no a priori covariance is provided.

selectedKeys.en: The original survey data could not be confirmed for calculation. This historical result is for review only.

selectedKeys.en: This result is incomplete or invalid and is available for audit only.

selectedKeys.en: Historical result locked for new computation

selectedKeys.en: Not eligible for epoch comparison, derived calculations or final deliverables.

selectedKeys.en: Initial-value history is unavailable. Reload it before confirming a change.

selectedKeys.en: Restore or reimport the retained original file.

selectedKeys.en: Original survey source integrity verified ({{count}} records). This does not indicate completed quality review, professional sign-off, standards review, or final delivery.

selectedKeys.en: One point per line: ID,height[,X,Y], in metres. Enter before choosing files. Explicit mappings are preserved with the import; conflicts block import and never replace source coordinates.

selectedKeys.en: Enter 1–10000 known-point rows, or leave blank to separate at an empty line.

selectedKeys.en: Heights and differences are in metres; route lengths are in kilometres.

selectedKeys.en: Enter a unique segment name and two different point names. A specified baseline must be positive. Tilt calculations require a horizontal baseline.

selectedKeys.en: Tilt uses the reference epoch's horizontal baseline or a specified measured baseline. Convergence can use horizontal, spatial or vertical distance. Point names must exist in both epochs.

selectedKeys.en: Up to {{count}} segments can be added.

selectedKeys.en: Without defined segments, only common-point displacement is analyzed.

selectedKeys.en: Choose the same segment and observations from two professional result periods to show observed and adjusted height-difference changes.

selectedKeys.en: Choose different periods, endpoints and observations for both periods.

selectedKeys.en: Adjusted coordinates or heights, corrections and point standard errors; use these to generate deliverables for review.

已计算点位中误差；项目限差需另行复核
selectedKeys.en: Point error computed; project tolerance requires separate review

selectedKeys.en: Calculate to view closure checks, observation corrections and precision results.

selectedKeys.en: Confirm the network, observations, and points before calculation. Open details when needed.

selectedKeys.en: Residual norms describe the adjusted fit. They do not replace an independent route misclosure or a tolerance assessment.

selectedKeys.en: Datum defect counts parameters not independently determined by the observations and constraints: the number of unknowns minus the rank of the coefficient matrix. This value does not establish standards compliance or professional approval.

selectedKeys.zh: 尚无已知控制点，请确认基准约束。
selectedKeys.en: No known control points. Confirm the datum constraints.
